newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil ends lower, downside potential limited.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil ends lower, downside potential limited.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL

PALM OIL FUTURES - Market ended lower, reversing an overnight firm trend, as prices fell on profit-taking and a technical correction to an overbought market. But losses were limited due to underlying firm fundamentals. March futures support level is 1,230 and resistance 1,250.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - Expectations of fresh tenders also checked the fall. Interest was seen among nearby CPOs.
Malaysia's Palm Oil Registration and Licensing Authority on Monday said output in November fell 13.83 percent to 762,540 tonnes from October.
Dealings were active due to selling."There was a lot of switching activities from January to March," another dealer said. Turnover was 2,063 lots against 3,663 on Tuesday.

Among physical, Dec (south) saw offers at 1,255 ringgit against bids at 1,250 after trading at 1,260 and 1,255. Dec (central) was offered at 1,250 and bids at 1,245 with earlier trades of 1,245 and 1,250.

"The fundamnetals look good in coming months. And prices should rise back after the brief correction," another trader said. Prices have recently risen because of the bullish December 1-15 palm oil export data released by cargo surveyor SGS (M)Sdn.
On Monday SGS (M) Sdn Bhd estimated Malaysia's palm oil exports for December 1-15 at 406,924 tonnes compared with 298,862 tonnes for November 1-15.
Traders expect bullish data for the whole December exports. They said expectation of lower output in coming months, because of the seasonal downtrend, could see prices rebound.
Jan (south) saw offers at 1,260 and bids at 1,250, and Jan (central) at 1,260 and bids at 1,250.
Feb (south) was offered at 1,260 and bids at 1,250.
Among refined products, Jan RBD palm oil was offered at $530 a tonne FOB Malaysia, and Feb/March at $530.

Jan RBD palm olein saw offers at $570, Feb/March at $565 and Apr/May/June at $560. Jan was traded at $572.50. Jan RBD palm stearin was offered at $400, Feb/Mar at $402.50 and Jan/Feb palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $292.50.
Third month March futures contract eased 10 ringgit to 1,232 ringgit ($488.11) --Tan Lee Lee +603-230-7510 ($1 =2.5240 rgt)
